classification.array_nullability: Five production arrays are intentionally stricter NOT NULL; no data/column change proposed.
classification.text_varchar: Three widened TEXT columns accept current valid input; retain to avoid truncating existing data.
classification.enum_order: Same labels; historical ALTER TYPE append order. Do not rebuild enums.
classification.foreign_keys: Renamed and stronger composite tenant relationships are preserved. Update-action differences involve immutable IDs; no cascade rewrite proposed.
classification.vendor_invoice_unique: Keep partial unique index excluding CANCELLED; do not impose unconditional Prisma uniqueness.
classification.redundant_company_id_unique: ID primary key already guarantees uniqueness on project change orders and loan payments. No additional unique index required.
classification.vendor_lookup: Existing(companyId,vendorId,vendorInvoiceNumberNormalized) index covers the declared leading prefix.
classification.ten_query_indexes: Prepared concurrent non-unique indexes to match the ten other missing declarative query shapes. Production performance improvement is not yet measured.
classification.zero_drift: Not claimed; documented migration-native constraints remain authoritative.
